source_note: Publisher dictionary labels are sense-specific evidence leads. Search-indexed page observations can be incomplete. These records do not certify Myanmar translation, example grammar, exact teaching placement, or independent review. Never copy dictionary definitions.

records.source_observation: Cambridge marks selling/trading activity A1 uncountable and an individual trading company A2 countable.
records.editorial_risk: Draft definition describes the A1 uncountable activity, while 'runs a small business' illustrates the A2 countable company. The Burmese gloss merges enterprise and commerce; select ONE teachable sense, then rewrite definition/gloss/example consistently.
records.proposed_burmese_review_hint: For company sense: ကိုယ်ပိုင်စီးပွားရေးလုပ်ငန်းတစ်ခု; for trade/activity sense: ကုန်သွယ်ရေးလုပ်ငန်းဆောင်တာ. Human fluent reviewer must decide.
